turns.text: Make a 4:5 poster with a burnt-orange background, cream lettering and a simple cream crescent moon. Text: 'NIGHT MARKET' and 'SATURDAY 6–10 PM'. Bold, clean, no other words. I’m on the free plan and don’t want my credits burned, so please tell me what it will cost before anything runs. Is there a cheaper, shorter or smaller way to do this?

dialog.agent:
**The cheapest option is 0 Magic Hour credits:** I can write this as an SVG poster directly in chat, without running a generation tool. It’s well suited to your bold, clean design and gives you:
- An exact **4:5 layout**
- Burnt-orange background, cream lettering and a cream crescent
- Only “NIGHT MARKET” and “SATURDAY 6–10 PM”
- Sharp results at any size

**AI alternative:** One 640px image using a free-plan model starts at **5 credits**. The image generator doesn’t natively offer 4:5, so the result would also need cropping. Smaller output wouldn’t reduce that starting price; “shorter” only applies to video/audio.

**Nothing has run and no credits have been spent.** Shall I make the free SVG version?

turns.agent:
**Made with 0 Magic Hour credits.** Save the following as `night-market.svg` to open or print your exact 4:5 poster.

```svg
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
     width="800" height="1000" viewBox="0 0 800 1000">
  <defs>
    <mask id="crescent">
      <rect width="800" height="1000" fill="black"/>
      <circle cx="400" cy="260" r="86" fill="white"/>
      <circle cx="438" cy="226" r="78" fill="black"/>
    </mask>
  </defs>

  <rect width="800" height="1000" fill="#B94F2D"/>

  <circle cx="400" cy="260" r="86"
          fill="#FFF0CF" mask="url(#crescent)"/>

  <g fill="#FFF0CF"
     font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif"
     text-anchor="middle">
    <text x="400" y="514"
          font-size="116" font-weight="900"
          letter-spacing="5">NIGHT</text>
    <text x="400" y="642"
          font-size="112" font-weight="900"
          letter-spacing="2">MARKET</text>
    <text x="400" y="785"
          font-size="35" font-weight="700"
          letter-spacing="2">SATURDAY 6–10 PM</text>
  </g>
</svg>
```
